SELECT DATE(create_time) AS date, -- 只取日期，如 2026-08-21 change_type AS change_type, -- IN/OUT SUM(change_quantity) AS total_qty -- 该日该类型数量求和 FROM stock_log
AND create_time >= #{startDate}
AND create_time <= CAST(CONCAT(#{endDate}, ' 23:59:59') AS DATETIME)
GROUP BY DATE(create_time), change_type ORDER BY date ASC, change_type ASC -- 按时间从早到晚
